notes: Site: IKEA DE (ikea.com/de/de), sibling of IKEA UK (SR92, same global platform). Tier 1 HTTP fetch of homepage showed only client-rendered mega-menu nav JSON (no product grid), so escalated to tier 2 Playwright, same as UK. Homepage nav JSON groups 'Letzte Chance' (Last Chance) under an 'Aktionen' (Promotions) group alongside 'Neuer niedriger Preis' (lower-price) and 'Produkte zum niedrigsten Preis' (lowest-price) - all three sound promotional at the nav-label level, so each was opened and individually tested against the Clearance-vs-Sale rule (Sec.3), not assumed from grouping alone. RESULT: only Letzte Chance qualifies. https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/last-chance/ (English URL slug kept on DE locale, matching UK's /gb/en/cat/last-chance/) opened with Playwright: h1 'Letzte Chance', on-page copy 'Dies ist die letzte Gelegenheit, diese beliebten IKEA Produkte zu kaufen. Du findest eine grosse Auswahl an Moebeln und Wohnaccessoires, die nur noch eine kurze Zeit erhaeltlich sind: von stilvollen Leuchten bis hin zu bequemen Sofas. Nur solange der Vorrat reicht.' (translation: last chance to buy these popular IKEA products - a wide range of furniture and home accessories available only for a short time longer, while stock lasts) - this is the site's own permanent end-of-line/outlet concept (products leaving the range, while stock lasts), directly matching the IKEA UK sibling's 'Last chance'/'leaving our range' language that was classified as Clearance there, so it clears the Sec.3 Clearance-vs-Sale test. Page text shows '295 Produkte' twice (page header + filter-panel header) - cross-checked, qty verified reliable. By contrast, the other two 'Aktionen' items were checked and EXCLUDED: https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/lower-price/ (h1 'Produkte zum niedrigsten Preis', meta description/og:title 'Sehr guenstige Moebel & Deko' = 'Very cheap furniture & decor') is a budget/low-price product listing, not an outlet or permanently-marked-down concept - no clearance/discontinued signal, temporary/pricing-tier framing only, excluded. https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/lowest-price/ was found to be the same underlying lowest-price/budget listing referenced by both nav labels ('Neuer niedriger Preis' and 'Produkte zum niedrigsten Preis' both route to variants of this budget-price concept) - also excluded, no products-listed check needed further since neither carries any outlet/discontinued/end-of-line signal. No generic 'Sale'/'Angebote'/'Ausverkauf' seasonal promo page was found positioned as a candidate at all (the top-level 'Angebote' nav tab leads to IKEA Family member offers and time-limited campaign banners, same temporary-promo shape the UK sibling excluded under /gb/en/offers/) - not recorded, consistent with the Clearance-vs-Sale rule. Checked homepage nav (all mega-menu groups), footer, and the 'Angebote' promotions hub for a German equivalent of 'Restposten'/'Raeumung'/'Ausverkauf'/'Outlet' - none found as a distinct listing beyond Letzte Chance. Did not need Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).

rows.evidence: Rendered page text (German, Playwright render of https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/last-chance/): '295 Produkte' shown twice - page header below h1 'Letzte Chance', and again in the filter-panel header. Site nav groups this under 'Aktionen'; on-page copy describes products 'nur noch eine kurze Zeit erhaeltlich' (available only a short time longer) and 'Nur solange der Vorrat reicht' (only while stock lasts) - permanent end-of-line/outlet merchandising, not a temporary seasonal sale.
